scope: The actual Village observer, exact production delta and unchanged verifier/call chain; no test or Android execution.

findings.finding: The complete visible Return-touch prefix is byte-identical, including native PID check, exact Spiele label, responsive original-image targeting, captured command and exactly-one-input assertion. The observer follows this one touch and contains no further navigation or launch input.

The existing global 900-second budget remains strict. A single local deadline is min(remaining global time,60 seconds), begins after the observed Return touch, and bounds inherited ADB reads, each capture/OCR and the accessibility child. The current monotonic time is checked again before accepting successful observations; exact-deadline and late arrivals fail. The local deadline is removed in finally and the full attempt journal is written.

Each attempt obtains new actual process/foreground-activity reads, verifies the same host PID, reads preferences, captures a uniquely named original PNG, checks unchanged render readiness, and verifies exact Spielen OCR against that same original PNG and TSV. It then requires fresh enabled same-package UI evidence. No old successful screenshot or row is reused by production.

The separate Python child imports the unchanged pr207_android_ui_probe from the explicit current ROOT/scripts/probes path and calls its real live_nodes method. The helper only connects/configures the UI reader and dumps the hierarchy. Actual exit code, complete stdout/stderr, timeout and partial streams are preserved; malformed/foreign/disabled UI cannot be accepted. Its successful exit is followed by the current deadline check.

Rejected observations retain their own frame, OCR/TSV/command/UI output and journal error. The common derivative OCR scratch image is renamed to an unused per-attempt path without overwrite. ValueError/RuntimeError/XML parse failures may cause another fresh observation only inside the same deadline. Timeout and other failures remain fatal.

The complete pure verifier remains original blob013fe059. It still independently verifies API35/current APK/source binding, original command receipts, the same host/native process chain, profile/learning preservation, actual entry and Return touches, native ready/HUD, exact Spielen TSV/PNG, live enabled same-package hierarchy, save/return acknowledgement and absence of actual runtime errors.

Inherited original ADB execution uses self.remaining(45) before and self.remaining() after each actual command, so the subclass local return deadline really applies. Preference reads remain the original exec-out cat flow.

Twelve new methods are present as separate additive cases: actual archived wrong Village frame; earlier valid main-frame provenance; controlled wrong→right observation sequence; persistent wrong frame; invalid UI; exact deadline; late successful UI; shrinking global budget; inherited ADB timeout; partial child streams; changed host; unique per-attempt derivative names. These cases were read, not run by this reviewer. Their earlier main frame is explicitly controlled input, not proof that the historical Village returned later.
